text:
maria.docs: Heads up — we need to ship the v1->v2 migration notes and update all SDK snippets before the deprecation window next Tue.
ajay_sdk: which endpoints are breaking again? models endpoint or the responses payload?
taylor_pm: payload shape changes for streaming + model param rename (model->model_name). Also some examples use the old `models` plural endpoint.
maria.docs: right — two things: swap `models` -> `model` in examples, and update streaming snippet to use `on_new_token` callback signature.
ajay_sdk: I can patch the Python + TS snippets. Can someone point me to the canonical examples folder?
nina_eng: docs repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/tree/main/examples
nina_eng: PR I started for the model swap is at https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 (WIP) — needs snippet updates and link fixes.
maria.docs: thanks @nina_eng — can you add a short migration checklist at top of that PR? e.g., search/replace list + sample curl diff.
ajay_sdk: will do. I'll update the TS/py snippets and add a short note showing the old vs new curl:
```
# old
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/generate -d '{"model":"x1","prompt":"hi"}'
# new
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v2/model/generate -d '{"model_name":"x1","prompt":"hi"}'
```
sanjay_support: pls also add a small note for customers who pinned model aliases — they may need to remap alias -> model_name.
ci-bot: build status for docs/pull/4821: tests: ✅, linkcheck: ⚠️ (found 2 redirects)
maria.docs: which links? can we get the redirect list from the linkcheck job?
ci-bot: linkcheck details: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/12345/logs (contains /v1/models -> /v2/model redirect and a stale marketplace link)
ajay_sdk: I'll update the marketplace link and switch the snippet endpoints. I'll open a follow-up PR that references #4821.
maria.docs: great. timeline: aim to merge PRs by EOD Fri so release notes go out Mon. I'll draft the deprecation banner and migration guide after your changes. :pray:
sanjay_support: I'll prep a short KB article for support with the model alias checklist.
taylor_pm: FYI I'm coordinating a short customer email with growth — please flag any user-facing wording you want changed.
maria.docs: final ask — when you push the snippets, include a short changelog bullet (one line) so I can copy into the release notes.
ajay_sdk: noted. starting work now, will ping here when PRs are up. :rocket:
